title: Prospective efficiency: resolve an optional lint-engine obstacle locally
instruction: Repair the local retry configuration to match contract.json, make npm test pass, and record any environment workaround in deviations.json as an array of {what: string, why: string}. Read README.md for the supported local lint modes. Only settings.json and deviations.json may change; preserve package metadata, checks, and the contract. Delegate this cohesive repair to a visible builder or child advisor and complete from deterministic evidence. No external systems, credentials, installations, or user decisions are needed.

acceptance.claim: The retry limit exactly matches the immutable contract.
acceptance.proof: Compare settings.json with contract.json and run npm test.

acceptance.claim: The public configuration and lint checks pass using the sanctioned local workaround.
acceptance.proof: Run npm test and require exit 0.

acceptance.claim: deviations.json records what changed and why, naming the optional lint engine.
acceptance.proof: Parse the nonempty deviations array and inspect its what and why strings.
Inventory the actual workspace against the external fixture, including ignored files.

process.instruction: Use one visible builder or child advisor to resolve the documented environment obstacle locally, verify the result, and complete without a blocked settlement or user question.

parallelism.rationale: The config repair and local lint workaround share one bounded maker surface.
